 What we offer: 
 At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.
 
 
 
 
 
 Group Summary: 
 Magna is an innovative leader in the development and manufacturing of high quality complete seating systems. Our solution includes seating structures, mechanisms and hardware, as well as foam and trim products for global automotive, heavy truck and bus industries. Our capabilities include market and consumer research; full concept development; design and engineering capabilities; testing, validation and world-class manufacturing. Our award-winning seating solutions are developed from consumer research, finding the ease of operation to be comfortable, convenient and connected. 
 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 







 About the Role 
 We are searching for an experienced OT Specialist (m/f/x) to join our Group Operational Technology team, with a focus on traditional OT and Camera / Vision system applications across Magna Seating Europe. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to the development of advanced manufacturing solutions, support digital transformation initiatives, and help define the future of automation within our organization
  
 Key Responsibilities 
 Collaborate with Magna Seating Europe teams to develop technical specifications and standards for new production equipment and automation solutions
 Lead and support projects with a focus on Camera applications and Vison system
 Act as a technical interface between local manufacturing teams, machine builders, suppliers, and cross-functional departments
 Provide expert technical consultation, knowledge sharing, and training to local engineering and operations teams
 Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technical standards and guidelines as a member of the Group OT Europe team
 Develop innovative and practical technical solutions for a wide range of manufacturing and automation challenges
 Provide technical leadership throughout the equipment development and implementation lifecycle, ensuring high-quality, efficient, and sustainable solutions
 Support commissioning, validation, and deployment activities when required
 Promote standardization and scalability of automation solutions across Magna Seating Europe
  
 What We Are Looking For 
 University degree or college diploma in Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline
 Alternatively, a minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience in a comparable technical role, preferably within the automotive or manufacturing industry
 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
 Ability to collaborate effectively within international and cross-functional teams
  
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with Siemens PLC, HMI, and SCADA systems
 Experience with Camera and vison systems – traditional and AI
 Knowledge of programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, VBA, or C#
 Understanding of Industrial IoT, OT cybersecurity principles, and industrial communication protocols, including PROFINET, MQTT, and OPC UA
 Understanding of OT networking
 Experience with databases and various data storage technologies
 Familiarity with project management methodologies such as Waterfall and Agile
 Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
 Strong understanding of Operational Technology (OT) systems and manufacturing environments
 Experience with digitalization, Industry 4.0, and smart manufacturing initiatives is an advantage
  
 Your personal skills 
 Excellent analytical and creative problem-solving skills
 Highly self-motivated and directed
 Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure
 Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
 Able to persuade / influence stakeholders to drive optimization and standards
  
 Location Benefits 
 A collegial working environment characterized by appreciation and recognition
 A wide range of opportunities for participation and personal development (training & education)
 Attractive offers and discounts
 Internationally oriented workplace
 Company events
 Awareness, Unity, Empowerment: 
 At Magna, we believe that a diverse workforce is critical to our success. That’s why we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We hire on the basis of experience and qualifications, and in consideration of job requirements, regardless of, in particular, color, ancestry, religion, gender, origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability or gender identity. Magna takes the privacy of your personal information seriously. We discourage you from sending applications via email or traditional mail to comply with GDPR requirements and your local Data Privacy Law.


 AI-Assisted Screening Disclosure 
 As part of our commitment to a fair, consistent, and efficient recruitment process, we may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in the initial screening of applications submitted through our Workday system. These tools help identify qualifications and experience that align with the role requirements. Please note that AI is used solely to support our recruiters. Final decisions are always made by the hiring manager and the hiring team. Importantly, no applicant data is shared externally through these AI tools. All information remains securely within our systems and is handled in accordance with our privacy and data protection policies.

 Under conditions defined by applicable law, you may have the right to request an explanation of how AI is used to support decision-making. 
 If you have any questions or concerns about this process, feel free to contact our Talent Attraction team.
